problems: bodyCol convention: the LEFT (odd) column of the OCR page on which the head sits; the right-hand column is on the same page, so Elenchus values one higher count as agree (+-1).
Several page headers are lost in OCR (583|584, 863|864, 1421|1422); those bodyCols are inferred from position between recognised headers.
Elenchus 'Orationes Laudatoria alieque nonnulla festive' prints 'col. 15'; the body also holds a Notitia/preface on cols 13-15 before the head (not itemised in the Elenchus).
